fields.title: Remember E-ink preferences separately on each device
fields.description: An unconfigured device should start in regular mode; an explicitly configured E-ink device remembers E-ink. The tested upgrade inherited einkMode=true; source defaults are already false.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P2. Sources R2, R9. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: Classify device-local settings and exclude them from cross-device upload/apply. Clean-profile default is off; explicit on survives local restarts; computer/phone settings do not override the E-ink device. Preserve migration and existing choices.
